correctness.rationale: Exact reduction n_i x_i^2/(1-x_i)=h gives all positive equilibria. Phi(h) decreases strictly from m/2 to zero, so the rate curve has a single nondegenerate minimum. Full node Jacobian splits into m class modes and N-m strictly negative deviations; similarity and rank-one congruence count its unstable directions exactly. Log-concavity of n u(h;n) yields the strict fixed-total balancing theorem. Verification code reproduces rational examples and bounded threshold comparisons; finite tests are supplemental, not the general proof.

value.rationale: The exact all-partition threshold makes a motivated structural question answerable: which division of a fixed number of members across mandatory cross-group encounters first permits stable endemic transmission? It gives the only full-system endemic fold, entire equilibrium inventory and inertia, and a strict optimal balance/minorization principle for arbitrary m, not merely a numerical example or the known homogeneous scalar fold.
